title: Append
prompt: Start with an empty array. Add a to the end, then b. Return the array.
signature: func solve(a: int, b: int) -> Array:
hint: append adds one item to the end. Call it twice.
solution:
func solve(a: int, b: int) -> Array:
	var items = []
	items.append(a)
	items.append(b)
	return items
